description: Add a new utility and keep docs in sync
---

Task:
1) Add the utility implementation.
2) Add/update tests or runnable examples.
3) Update the utilities signature docs to match the code.
4) If docs are generated, run the doc task and commit the result.

Context:
- Utilities reference is in docs/bundlejs-utilities.md.
- Keep changes minimal; no refactors unless necessary.
